sections.content: Explain social inequality with *porque*, ya *que*, *debido* a and por. Use these structures to connect a social condition with an explanation, while avoiding the assumption that one cause explains every situation.

items.spanish: La desigualdad existe porque los recursos no se distribuyen igual.
items.english: Inequality exists because resources are not distributed equally.

items.spanish: Algunas personas have fewer opportunities debido a su situación económica.
items.english: Some people have fewer opportunities due to their economic situation.

items.spanish: El desempleo puede aumentar la pobreza.
La situación es compleja, ya que existen varias causas.
items.english: The situation is complex, since there are several causes.

sections.content: Use a causal connector to explain a condition, then add a second factor when the explanation is more complex.
